Russell Brand Sentenced for Rape and Sexual Assault; New Allegations Emerge

Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and 6 months in prison for rape and sexual assault. A judge described him as a "sexual predator" during sentencing. The sentencing occurred in a "squalid and unsafe" London jail. In the wake of his conviction, detectives have received a string of new allegations. Jemima Goldsmith, identified as Brand's ex, has accused him of "violence and abuse" and stated she "had to call police after violent incident." Some figures, including Megyn Kelly and Elon Musk, have defended Brand following his conviction.
